name: Interns of Ecstasy Island
source:
[i][b]Welcome to the Isle de Extasis Resort! It’s a once in a life time opportunity on an island paradise. You may never leave…[/b][/i]

As a fairly average man entering your third year of university, you thought you’d been awarded the opportunity of a lifetime when you were chosen out of countless others to get a summer internship at an exclusive, tropical resort.

The girls at the resort are all beautiful. Most are pretty slutty, too.

The last thing you expected was that you might be [b]turned into one of them[/b]!

[From [url=https://usagitriplesix.home.blog/projects/interns-of-ecstasy-island/]official website[/url]]
translation:
[i][b]欢迎来到埃塔西斯岛度假村！这是在岛屿天堂上千载难逢的机会。你可能永远不会离开……[/b][/i]

作为一个进入大学三年级的相当普通的人，当你从无数人中脱颖而出，在一个独特的热带度假胜地进行暑期实习时，你以为自己获得了千载难逢的机会。

度假村里的姑娘个个都很漂亮。大多数也很放荡。

你最没想到的是你可能会[b]变成他们中的一员[/b]！

[来自[url=https://usagitriplesix.home.blog/projects/interns-of-ecstasy-island/]官网[/url]]
